title: A quotient of a sober space by an equivalence relation with finite fibres and lifting generalizations is Kolmogorov
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the Kolmogorov property of a quotient of a sober space by a finite-fibre equivalence relation along which generalizations lift, with the quotient map open (author lemma at source lines 3932-3945, label lemma-quotient-kolmogorov). The proof (source lines 3947-3979) uses all five hypotheses in a chain: finiteness of fibres turns points of the quotient into finite equivalence classes, the lifting property transfers specializations between representatives, and the openness of the map together with sobriety of the source is what supplies the open set that separates two points whose classes differ. The statement is one of the technical steps by which the author controls quotients of sober spaces in this chapter. H2.
